entries.heading: None of the funds made available by this Act may be used
ancestors: DIVISION A—-AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2018
entries.text:
Sec. 768.  None of the funds made available by this Act may be used 
in contravention of--
            (1) section 9(b)(10) of the Richard B. Russell National 
        School Lunch Act (42 U.S.C. 1758(b)(10)); or
            (2) section 245.8 of title 7, Code of Federal Regulations.
